payload.text: hv's ruling of 2026-11-17, given to vc in the live channel (vc's question dialog, answered twice, read at 07:33Z by vc's date -u), in hv's wording, recorded by vc as mediator. On ic's todo 7 (ways into the ccusage panel from inside Herdr), hv first asked: "I don't get what happens with 'tab' here? I can add the cmd-shift-u to keys.json, but what does that have to do with tab?" vc answered that a tab is one of Herdr's own tabs and tab.new the command that opens one, as ccusage herdr launch runs. hv: "Ah. I see. I got confused with the tab key. Yes, cmd-shift-u in its own full-sized tab in Herdr is what I want." vc's reading: ic's way (a). hv adds one line to the global section of Molt-matts' config/herdr-app/keys.json, which Herdr reads live: "cmd-shift-u": {"command": "tab.new", "args": {"name": "ccusage", "mod": "ccusage"}}. No ccusage change; the popup toggle (mod.open with an overlay in ccusage's mod.json) is not taken.
